# Provenance

This generic baseline was derived locally from an immutable, validated foundation
snapshot at tag `v0.1.0` and commit `5d616a3`. Phase 2 removed the source product's
business specification, owner identity, workflow language, and publication remote while
preserving reusable engineering, security, data, and delivery controls.

The derived repository intentionally starts as unpublished local work. Its adopter should
review and commit the Phase 2 transformation as an independent history before publishing.
